question: Is there an explicit remainder bound with constants for the large-multiplier limit, and does it hold at every declared condition?
scope_note: MODEL-ONLY. No campaign chemical outcome is read: no y, J, J_min, J_inf, threshold, profile component, tail classification or shoulder appears here or is computed. Permitted before the P0-G0 freeze on that basis.

contract.output: cup functional m_cum(T)/Vol(T); output norm is absolute value
contract.horizon: t in [0, T] with T the matched-endpoint shot time, in units of TC
contract.semigroup_bound: ||exp(t A1) Q|| <= M exp(-gamma t), M = cond2(V_fast)
contract.propagation_to_J: the state bound C/kappa maps to the cup output by |f(kappa) - f_inf| <= C/(kappa * Vol(T)), and the exact weighted-median profile is 1-Lipschitz in f on the relative scale, so |J(kappa) - J_inf| <= 100 * max_i (1/y_i) * C/(kappa*Vol(T)). The y-dependent factor is evaluated ONLY inside P0-G8 after activation; it is not computed here.

coverage.deduplication_proof: the pencil depends on (T, p, solute) only; variety enters solely through the measured concentrations y, which this module never reads. Each computed cell therefore covers both varieties, and the declared 54-cell coverage is complete.

fitness_for_purpose.reading: The bound is ESTABLISHED — index-one structure verified, Lyapunov constants derived, 27 of 27 operator-distinct cells pass, every finite-kappa check holds. It is NOT USABLE for its stated purpose. Protocol V2 requires this bound to propagate into the J_inf interval; at a median looseness of 4.9e+13 the resulting [L_inf, U_inf] would swamp every tolerance and return boundary_indeterminate for all six groups, making P0-G8 vacuous rather than informative. The looseness comes from bounding the slow-fast-slow coupling by a product of separate block operator norms (||P A0 Q|| ~ 8.5e3 times ||Q A0 P|| ~ 4.5e3) instead of tracking the composite operator. A usable bound needs the composite treated directly, or the output functional carried through the derivation rather than bounding the full state first.
fitness_for_purpose.consequence: PR-03 does not close for P0-G8 purposes; P0-G8 remains blocked.
